objectives.title: Gather wood
objectives.note: Teaches Interact; one or two trees.

objectives.title: Eat something
objectives.note: A hunger wait: the player eats once energy falls below 90, about a minute in.

objectives.title: Found a settlement
objectives.note: Fast when the wood was gathered while waiting to eat.

objectives.title: Grow your nation to 5
objectives.note: Under 5 s means settlers had joined before the step came up and the player did nothing for it. Before seasons and regions (#318) seed 3 finished in 1 s. Advisory since trade caravans and living prices (#321): which nationless settlers exist near the player is decided by market rolls on the world's main stream, so any change to trading reshuffles it. With #321 seed 3 never finishes (its camp falls to sieges every three minutes and the bot has no settlers left to recruit) and seed 11 finishes in 1 s, while seeds 6 to 15 take as long in all as on develop.

objectives.title: Sell resources at market
objectives.note: Waits for a settler to buy a stall and earn coins to pay with.

objectives.title: Grow your nation to 10
objectives.note: Advisory until sieges stop taking a new player's settlements in the first ten minutes (docs/PACING.md, known issues).

objectives.title: Amass 500 coins
objectives.note: Advisory. Usually already met when it comes up: coins plus the treasuries pass 500 during the arc.

objectives.title: Survive to day 2
objectives.note: Ends with the clock, so it measures how far into day 1 the earlier ambitions finished.
